clue.text: Keen, though boring

definitions.meaning: keen as in sharp or incisive, of a mind or a gaze
boring as in drilling or piercing through something

explanation.surface: Someone eager despite being dull company.
explanation.definitionFit: A piercing look or intellect is sharp, and a drill that pierces right through bores into its material.

clue.text: Lead a number in deeper possibly

indicators.note: in places the number inside the rearranged letters
possibly says the letters of deeper could be arranged some other way

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: A runner leads a group of competitors in the deeper water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges DEEPER into PREEDE, and 'in' puts C inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To lead is to go in front of, which is what coming before means.

clue.text: Critical about a certain point that's relative

indicators.note: about means the word for critical goes round the point

parts.note: nice in its old sense of fastidious and discriminating, hence critical
E is one of the compass points, east

explanation.surface: A fussy remark about a precise point concerning a family member.
explanation.walkthrough: NICE here means finely discriminating, as in a nice distinction, not pleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: A brother's or sister's daughter is a family member.

clue.text: Draw a circle round "Teetotal", plainly amused

indicators.note: round says the word for a draw goes about the teetotal abbreviation

parts.note: a draw in a match is a tie
a ring is a circle

explanation.surface: Someone sketches a ring round a 'Teetotal' sign, visibly finding it funny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Draw' looks like a verb about sketching, but it is the noun: a tie in a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Giggling nervously or quietly is a visible show of being entertained.

clue.text: Short article concerning the unknown

parts.note: an is the short indefinite article
on means about or concerning, as in a talk on art

explanation.surface: A brief newspaper piece on a mystery.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is the usual short form of anonymous, the label for an unnamed author.
explanation.definitionFit: The abbreviation for anonymous marks a writer whose name nobody knows.

clue.text: This month all Sunday opening gets established

parts.note: inst., short for instant, means of the current month in old business letters
taken as written

indicators.note: opening means the first letter of Sunday

explanation.surface: A notice says that this month all Sunday opening hours are being fixed.
explanation.walkthrough: INST is an old commercial abbreviation for this month, as in 'your letter of the 5th inst.'
explanation.definitionFit: To install something is to set it up or settle it in place.

clue.text: It looks like a sea-perch

definitions.meaning: one who stares with mouth open is a starer
a name for the comber, a fish of the sea-perch family

explanation.surface: Something resembles a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: One who stares open-mouthed is a gawker, and the same word names the comber, a small fish.

clue.text: Shoot when gun-bore has been settled

indicators.note: settled says the letters of gun-bore have been put into a new order

explanation.surface: Fire once the gun barrel has been sorted out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shoot' suggests firing the gun, but it is the verb for a plant sprouting.
explanation.definitionFit: Plants that sprout new growth are said to shoot or bud.

clue.text: Some turned and rushed around, being beaten

indicators.note: around means the word for rushed goes round the other piece

parts.note: sped means rushed

indicators.note: turned means the word for some is read backwards

parts.note: part means some, as in part of the crowd

explanation.surface: A few people spun round and dashed about while being defeated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' is not a quantity word here but PART; 'turned' reverses it and 'around' wraps the word for rushed round the result.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone strapped has been thrashed with a leather belt.

clue.text: Making great efforts from sixteen — or otherwise

indicators.note: otherwise says the letters of sixteen and or are to be arranged differently

explanation.surface: A team makes huge efforts from sixteen players or some other number.
explanation.walkthrough: 'otherwise' rearranges SIXTEEN and OR.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard strenuous labours are big efforts.

clue.text: Father giving a light slap with little hesitation

parts.note: a pat is a light tap or slap
er is the short sound of hesitating

explanation.surface: A dad gives a gentle smack after a brief pause.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is Latin for father, used in old-fashioned British schoolboy slang.
explanation.definitionFit: This Latin word for a male parent survives as dated British slang for dad.

clue.text: Constantly receiving direction from the press

indicators.note: receiving means the word for constantly takes in the direction

parts.note: ever means always or constantly
NE is the compass direction north-east

explanation.surface: Someone always taking orders from the newspapers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the press' looks like the media, but here a press is a device that flattens, which is what this word names; 'receiving' puts the direction after the first three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A press is a device that flattens things, making surfaces level and smooth.

clue.text: Bearing 16

definitions.meaning: bearing as in posture or deportment
16 down's answer, the conveying of people or goods

explanation.surface: Bearing sixteen.
explanation.definitionFit: Deportment is how one holds oneself, and a horse-drawn coach is a means of conveyance.

clue.text: Bring on late in error

indicators.note: in error says the letters of late in are to be read wrongly, in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone brings something in late by mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in error' signals rearranging LATE IN; the 'in' of that phrase is also part of the letters, so 'error' alone is the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring on a consequence is to involve or necessitate it.

clue.text: Cut short, but aren't cut badly

indicators.note: badly says the letters of aren't cut are put in a poor order

explanation.surface: Things are trimmed but are not cut properly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' rearranges AREN'T CUT; the apostrophe adds no letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To shorten something by chopping off the end is to trim it.

clue.text: Making homes secure causes confused excitement

parts.note: flats are homes, apartments
to pin is to fasten or secure

explanation.surface: Locking up apartments leads to a state of panic.
explanation.walkthrough: A flat spin is a state of agitated panic, from an aircraft spinning out of control horizontally.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a dither or panic is a state of agitated confusion.

clue.text: 12 bringing delight?

definitions.meaning: 12 across's answer, a vehicle or means of conveyance
an overwhelming feeling of joy or rapture

explanation.surface: Does a vehicle bring joy?
explanation.definitionFit: A coach is a means of conveyance, and rapture is a state that carries someone away.

clue.text: House servant may cheat me of putting good man in charge

parts.note: to do someone is to cheat them
taken as written
ST, short for saint, a good man

explanation.surface: A maid might swindle me by putting a good man in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'do' is slang for cheat; ST stands for saint, the crossword's good man.
explanation.definitionFit: A maid or cleaner employed in a household is a home help.

clue.text: A way to encourage the caviar-producer

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
to urge on is to encourage

explanation.surface: A method of coaxing a fish that yields caviar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A way' suggests a method; it is ST, street.
explanation.definitionFit: This large fish's roe is the delicacy served as caviar.

clue.text: Red mark allowed

parts.note: a scar is a mark left on skin
let means allowed or permitted

explanation.surface: A red mark is permitted.
explanation.definitionFit: A bright vivid crimson shade is a red.

clue.text: Norse god losing his hair?

definitions.meaning: the god of light in Norse myth, son of Odin
more hairless, the comparative of bald

explanation.surface: A Viking deity is going bald.
explanation.definitionFit: Odin's radiant son, killed by mistletoe, shares his name with the comparative of hairless.

clue.text: Adverts about Oriental jackets

indicators.note: about means the word for adverts goes round the other piece

parts.note: to advert to something is to refer to it, so adverts means refers
E for east, the Orient

explanation.surface: Advertisements about Asian coats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Adverts' is not advertisements but the verb: adverts to, refers to.
explanation.definitionFit: Short double-breasted coats worn by sailors are reefer coats.

clue.text: First spoken to one holding the price note

indicators.note: holding means the word for one encloses the price

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards
the cost is the price
D is a musical note

explanation.surface: A person bearing the bill is the first to be addressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' is the ace in a pack of cards.
explanation.definitionFit: Being approached and addressed by a stranger is being spoken to first.

clue.text: Import spirit

definitions.meaning: import as in meaning or significance
the spirit of a text, its gist

explanation.surface: Bring in alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: The meaning of a statement is its gist, which is also its spirit, as against the letter.

clue.text: American expert fit for employment

parts.note: able means skilled or expert

explanation.surface: An American specialist is ready to be hired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fit for employment' suggests a job; it means can be put to use.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that can be put to use is serviceable.

clue.text: She is free to live outside

indicators.note: outside means the word for to live goes round the other piece

parts.note: to be is to exist or live
to rid is to free

explanation.surface: A woman is at liberty to live out of doors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'She' is a fair, if vague, definition: a woman at her wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman getting married is a she, so the pronoun stands for her.

clue.text: A little problem made to appear novel

indicators.note: A little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A small difficulty was made to seem new.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition, 'to appear novel', cannot stand for the answer; 'to appear' is a link and 'novel' alone is the definition, Jane Austen's book.
explanation.definitionFit: Jane Austen's 1815 book about a matchmaking heroine is a famous work of fiction.

clue.text: The French can write this language

parts.note: la is French for the
a tin is a can

explanation.surface: A French person can write in this tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can' looks like a verb; it is a tin.
explanation.definitionFit: The tongue of ancient Rome is a classical language.

clue.text: Get up behind time when put off

indicators.note: behind puts the word for get up after the word for time

parts.note: tempo is musical time
to rise is to get up

explanation.surface: Someone rises late when delayed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get up' comes first in the clue, but 'behind' places it after TEMPO.
explanation.definitionFit: To stall or delay a decision to gain time is to procrastinate.

clue.text: A charming woman!

parts.note: reads as a delightful lady, but charming means casting spells, so a witch or sorceress

explanation.definitionFit: A sorceress casts charms, and the word also means a captivatingly attractive woman.
